$comment: workflow-enablement.json -- every workflow whose forge state is NOT active.
Enforcer: src/Core.TypeScript/ci/workflow-enablement.ts, run in the drift (loud) job.
A disabled workflow sits at its correct path, is valid YAML, is named by prose and by
rosters, and produces ZERO runs. No run means no red X, so it is the vacuity class in its
purest administrative form -- and every workflow guard in this repo reads TEXT, so none of
them can see it. The state lives only in the forge.
THIS FILE IS A RECORD, NOT A PERMISSION. An entry does not approve the disablement; it says
somebody wrote the fact down. classification=unreviewed means exactly that nobody has
decided yet, and every run prints those entries so that unreviewed cannot quietly become
The audit goes RED when: a non-active workflow is missing here (the next silent
disablement); an entry here is active again (a stale row hides the next real one); an entry
names a path the forge does not list; an entry has no reason or a bad classification.

classifications.intentional: A maintainer decided this lane should not run, and the reason says why.
classifications.unreviewed: Measured disabled. Nobody has decided. Reported as a warning on every run.
